title: Anthropic transport with separated credentials and bounded retry

outcomes.statement: Calls reach the vendor API under an endpoint-specific header policy with declared rate limits and bounded retry/backoff, and a credential routed to the wrong capability fails closed before any request leaves the process.
outcomes.demo: An Analytics key routed to a user-management endpoint is rejected without issuing a request; the per-minute budget and retry ceiling are observable against deterministic fixtures.

uncertainties.statement: No live Anthropic credentials exist; the live provider probe is blocked on per-org keys and invite-canary authorization.
uncertainties.resolution: Scope is deterministic fixtures backed by passing Pact consumer contracts. Live credential-scope, organization-binding, pagination, rate-limit and invite acceptance stay gated behind the authorized provider run named in the parent story's AC4, and must not be claimed here.

uncertainties.statement: Probe code under scripts/probes/** cannot be imported by the connector, because that path is exempted from the provider-boundary lint for the probe's benefit only.
uncertainties.resolution: Semantics are ported into packages/connectors/src/providers/anthropic/, the other exempt path, and re-implemented against the connector's own contracts so core code keeps importing only the vendor-neutral interface.

uncertainties.statement: Retry must not amplify load against a rate-limited provider.
uncertainties.resolution: The retry budget shares the same limiter as first attempts, asserted by a test proving a retry storm cannot exceed the declared per-minute ceiling.

uncertainties.statement: The documented rate limits are declared, not measured.
uncertainties.resolution: They are encoded as configuration (100/min user management, 60/min analytics, 1200 invites/hour) and asserted against fixtures. Confirming real provider behavior belongs to the gated live provider run.

dependencies.reason: The sanitized journal wraps this transport's request and response objects, so the seam must exist first.
Capability conformance and the Pact consumer contracts are written against this transport.
